title: Remove tautological 'DashboardStats model' test in parent_dashboard_aggregator_test.dart

evidence.quote: // ParentDashboardData has no mostRecentlyActive, but we test data construction

why: The test constructs a ParentDashboardData literal and then asserts its fields equal the literal values it was just given — it exercises no aggregator logic. Its own inline comment admits the field it was meant to check (mostRecentlyActive) doesn't exist on the class. A broken aggregator would never fail this test.
recommendation: Delete the 'DashboardStats model' group, or replace it with a real assertion against ParentDashboardAggregator.compute() output if a 'most recently active curriculum' feature is still wanted.
acceptance_criteria: No remaining test that only re-asserts constructor inputs back at itself.
